- If two applicable rules lead to different outcomes, the lower-numbered rule decides.

- If the pre-approval flag is yes and the grade is anything other than G5, Rule 7 does not apply.
- If the number of claims this quarter is 8 or more, Rule 4 does not apply.

EXCEPTIONS

state.policy:
Expense claim handling

RULES
(1) If the number of claims this quarter is 5 or higher and the record shows no for the pre-approval flag, the request is escalated to a human reviewer.
(2) If the pre-approval flag is yes, the request is approved.
(3) If the number of claims this quarter is less than 5 and the claim amount is under 50 EUR, the request is approved.
(4) If the claim amount is above 1000 EUR and the record shows yes for the duplicate suspicion flag, the request is denied.
(5) If the claim amount exceeds 1000 EUR and the number of claims this quarter is at least 8, the request is escalated to a human reviewer.
(6) If the record shows no for the pre-approval flag and the time since the expense is at least 90 days, the request is denied.
(7) If the duplicate suspicion flag is set to yes and the case has the pre-approval flag set to no, the request is escalated to a human reviewer.
(8) If the record shows yes for the duplicate suspicion flag and the number of claims this quarter is 3 or higher, the request is denied.
(9) If the number of claims this quarter is less than 3 and the duplicate suspicion flag is set to no, the request is approved.
(10) If the claim amount is between 150 and 500 EUR inclusive and the duplicate suspicion flag is yes and the cost centre equals CC-455, the request is denied.
(11) If the cost centre is any of CC-455 or CC-512 and the case has the pre-approval flag set to no, the request is escalated to a human reviewer.
(12) If the company card use flag is yes and the number of claims this quarter is under 2 and the cost centre is among CC-204 or CC-310, the request is approved.

EXCEPTIONS
Rule 11 does not apply when the time since the expense is below 14 days and the case has the company card use flag set to yes.
Rule 6 does not apply when the claim amount is at most 150 EUR and the record shows no for the duplicate suspicion flag.
Rule 1 does not apply when the time since the expense is 60 days or less.

GENERAL
If two applicable rules lead to different outcomes, the higher-numbered rule decides.
When none of the rules applies, deny the request.
